mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with meclizine (anticholinergic antihistamine) increases risk of CNS depression, anticholinergic effects, and potential hypertensive crisis if meclizine formulation contains sympathomimetics.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic toxicity, and blood pressure changes; consider alternative antiemetics without anticholinergic properties.
